headline: Staff update on carrying out tax proposals, plus public comment and next steps for the proposals.
summary: Clerk/Treasurer staff will discuss how the tax proposals would be put into effect. Residents can give verbal comments during the public forum, and the group will talk about next steps.
items: Clerk/Treasurer staff on implementing tax proposals
